name: heating-equipment-selection
description: Корень репозитория: API в папке backend, UI в папке frontend.

scripts.dev:full: npx --yes concurrently -k -n api,ui -c blue,green "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build --prefix frontend && node scripts/vercelPrepareOutput.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run verify:type-bypass && npm run verify:auth-docs && npm run verify:deploy-docs && npm run verify:backend-docs && npm run verify:language-policy && npm run verify:shared && npm run verify:backend && npm run verify:frontend
scripts.e2e:install: npm --prefix e2e install && npm --prefix e2e run install:browsers
scripts.e2e:personas:prod: cd e2e && TARGET=prod npx playwright test specs/personas.spec.ts
